name: Independent Analytics for MainWP
author: Ben Sibley

sections.description:
Independent Analytics for MainWP is a free extension that lets you see stats for all your sites in one place.

How to setup this plugin

To use this plugin, you will install it on your site MainWP dashboard site. Once activated, visit the MainWP overview page, and click the “Sync” button at the top of the page. You will then see the Independent Analytics widget appear at the bottom of the page.

How to use this plugin

Once installed, you will find a new Independent Analytics widget available in the Overview menu. It displays a chart and the number of views and visitors from the past 30 days.

Using the dropdown in the widget, you can quickly switch between each website. This makes it easy to get a look at the performance of many different websites, without visiting each analytics dashboard individually.

If you want to open the full analytics menu for any particular site, just click the “Open Dashboard” button in the widget.

A similar widget is available when viewing the MainWP dashboard for any individual site.
sections.installation:
1. Please install the “MainWP Dashboard” plugin and active it before installing the Independent Analytics for MainWP plugin
  2. Upload the independent-analytics-for-mainwp folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Activate the Independent Analytics for MainWP plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  4. In the MainWP overview, click the “Sync” button at the top of the site
sections.faq:
Does each child site need Independent Analytics?

Yes, each child site needs to be running the Independent Analytics plugin to have stats pulled into the parent dashboard.

Does the parent site need to use Independent Analytics?

No, the parent site hosting the MainWP dasboard only needs the Independent Analytics for MainWP plugin installed.
